description: GLM-5.2-FP8 13-stage vLLM layer-pipeline runtime for Spark-ring frontier testing through DSAPI. spark0 is the API ingress; stage boundaries are aligned to GLM IndexShare full-indexer layers. The checked-in baseline uses dense TRITON_MLA with FP8 KV because the SM12 sparse FlashMLA BF16 fallback timed out during direct smoke.

admission.power_policy: GLM-5.2-FP8 is expected to need the full Spark ring. Stop resident peer services before launch unless a live memory check proves enough headroom. The resident lane must support both large chat and high-throughput batch: vLLM launches with a 262144-token context and 128-sequence capacity, while DSAPI dispatches deterministic 80-request throughput cohorts under 32768 reserved tokens. If the first ready request is larger than the token budget it runs alone, and the dispatcher backfills small work up to the 80-active target while the active long/tail cohort is below the low watermark. vLLM chunks long prefill scheduling at 8192 tokens while keeping the overlay-supported default single partial prefill, so large chat prompts avoid a single oversized prefill step.

vllm.required_source: guarded vLLM 0.23.0 wheel overlay with GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM support, DS4 ready-response compatibility shim, dense TRITON_MLA attention selected on Spark GB10, FP8 E4M3 KV cache storage, DS4 sparse-indexer dense fallback for unsupported SM12 DeepGEMM indexer kernels, DS4 Triton MLA tuning knobs, and DS4 runtime-patched PP TCP tensor-dict transport with upstream PP device communicator disabled
